summary: Partial implementation of requested Attendance access fix: frontend Attendance tab adds explicit error UI and appears to support role-based admin controls; backend changes shown only address user profile authorization, with no visible changes for Attendance data endpoints (getWorkers/getAttendanceRecords/getWorkerAttendance) required for staff access. Additional unrequested project metadata file was added, and Internet Identity hook was modified without an explicit requirement.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update backend authorization so authenticated non-admin staff principals can call user-level Attendance endpoints (at minimum: getWorkers, getAttendanceRecords, getWorkerAttendance, getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile) while keeping anonymous denied and admin-only endpoints restricted.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows authorization changes for getCallerUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile, but provides no evidence that Attendance data endpoints (getWorkers/getAttendanceRecords/getWorkerAttendance) were updated to allow staff (user-level) access; those methods are not shown being guarded/authorized appropriately in the provided backend diff snippet.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure Attendance Register is accessible to non-admin staff users and admin-only actions remain restricted (staff can view workers/attendance without authorization traps; add/mark attendance stays restricted).
missing_requirements.reason: The frontend AttendanceTab references isAdmin and uses worker/attendance queries, but the diff summary does not show the Dashboard tab visibility logic nor definitive evidence that non-admin staff can successfully fetch workers/attendance without backend Unauthorized traps. Backend changes shown do not cover Attendance endpoints, so end-to-end staff access is not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a new project tracking/metadata file (project_state.json) describing the request and project state.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask to add project state/metadata files; it only requested backend authorization and frontend error-state/access fixes.

No requirement requested changes to the Internet Identity hook; authentication provider changes were explicitly a non-goal (only II), and the diff does not tie this change directly to Attendance access requirements.
